title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28.2): Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces seven new read-only APIs for analyzing approval workflows, enabling auditors and IT staff to build advanced compliance reports in Power BI and intelligent automation with Copilot Studio while maintaining security through isolated API permissions.
key_points: Seven new API V2.0 endpoints provide read-only access to workflow approval data including workflows, steps, approvers, and approval entries
APIs enable secure external auditing and compliance reporting without modifying approval system data
Organizations can integrate with Power BI, Copilot Studio, and MCP Server for analytics and intelligent automation
Permission isolation ensures robust security while empowering authorized teams to access and analyze approval workflows

quotes.text: This feature enhances transparency and control by enabling secure, read-only access to approval workflows and user actions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core business value of the new APIs for governance and accountability

quotes.text: By isolating permissions for API access, organizations maintain robust security while empowering authorized teams to innovate confidently.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how security and functionality are balanced through permission isolation

quotes.text: Businesses can leverage these APIs to build advanced auditing and compliance reports in tools like Power BI, ensuring stronger governance.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates practical use cases for the new APIs in external reporting and compliance scenarios
